en.long_description: Generate images from text prompts. This hosted Bit uses OpenRouter through the Flow-Like server and does not download model files. Generates one image per request. Available aspect ratios, sizes, quality levels, and formats depend on the model. Image editing with reference images is not available through this Bit.
